column3: AX-200 Data Sheet · Rev. C · March 2026

The AX-200 is a digital temperature sensor with an I2C interface and a 12-bit resolution. It operates from 2.7 V to 5.5 V and draws less than 250 µA in active mode. An open-drain alert output signals when the temperature crosses a programmable limit.
Unless otherwise noted, limits apply at VDD = 3.3 V and an ambient temperature of 25 °C.

The temperature register is read with a two-byte transfer. The following sketch assumes the default address of 0x48.

// Read the temperature register Wire.beginTransmission(0x48); Wire.write(0x00); Wire.endTransmission(); Wire.requestFrom(0x48, 2); int raw = (Wire.read() << 8) | Wire.read(); float celsius = raw / 128.0;
